units.title: Facts and Number Sense
units.blurb: Know addition facts from memory and sort numbers into even and odd.

units.title: Place Value to 1,000
units.blurb: Hundreds, tens and ones: read, write, compare and place numbers to 1,000.

units.title: Adding and Subtracting within 100
units.blurb: Use place value to add and subtract two-digit numbers, and solve one- and two-step problems.

units.title: Adding and Subtracting within 1,000
units.blurb: Add and subtract three-digit numbers with models and written methods, and explain why they work.

units.title: Measuring Length
units.blurb: Measure with rulers, compare lengths, estimate, and solve length problems.

units.title: Time and Money
units.blurb: Tell time to five minutes and count money.

units.title: Graphs and Line Plots
units.blurb: Make and read picture graphs, bar graphs and line plots.

units.title: Shapes, Arrays and Equal Shares
units.blurb: Name shapes by their sides and angles, build arrays, and split shapes into equal shares.

topics.title: Facts within 20 from Memory
topics.short: Know all sums of two one-digit numbers by heart.

topics.title: Even and Odd Numbers
topics.short: An even number splits into two equal groups or pairs.
topics.trouble: Children judge even or odd by the tens digit, or think 0 is neither.

topics.title: 100 Is Ten Tens
topics.short: Ten tens make one hundred.

topics.title: Hundreds, Tens and Ones
topics.short: 352 is 3 hundreds, 5 tens and 2 ones.
topics.trouble: Children write 3 hundreds and 4 ones as 34 or 3004, missing the 0 that holds the tens place.

topics.title: Skip Counting by 5s, 10s and 100s
topics.short: Count by fives, tens and hundreds within 1,000.

topics.title: Three Ways to Write a Number
topics.short: Write numbers in digits, words and expanded form.
topics.trouble: Children write "four hundred six" as 4006, writing each spoken part.

topics.title: Comparing Three-Digit Numbers
topics.short: Compare hundreds first, then tens, then ones.

topics.title: Numbers on a Number Line
topics.short: Place numbers on a line with equally spaced marks.
topics.trouble: Children count the tick marks instead of the jumps, or space the marks unevenly.

topics.title: 10 or 100 More or Less
topics.short: Change one digit to add or subtract 10 or 100 in your head.

topics.title: Trading 10 Ones for 1 Ten
topics.short: Regrouping changes how a number is shown, not how much it is.
topics.trouble: Children think regrouping changes the number's value, so they do not trust the result.

topics.title: Adding Two-Digit Numbers
topics.short: Add tens and ones, regrouping when there are 10 or more ones.
topics.trouble: Children forget to add the new ten, so 38 + 47 comes out as 75.

topics.title: Subtracting Two-Digit Numbers
topics.short: Break a ten into ones when there are not enough ones.
topics.trouble: Children subtract the smaller digit from the larger in each column, so 52 − 27 comes out as 35.

topics.title: Adding Up to Four Numbers
topics.short: Add several two-digit numbers using place value.

topics.title: Adding and Subtracting on a Number Line
topics.short: Show sums and differences as jumps.

topics.title: Word Problems within 100
topics.short: Solve add-to, take-from, part-whole and compare stories.
topics.trouble: Children pick the operation from a key word like "left" or "more" instead of picturing what happens.

topics.title: Two-Step Word Problems
topics.short: Solve stories that need two steps.
topics.trouble: Children stop after the first step and give that number as the answer.

topics.title: Adding Three-Digit Numbers
topics.short: Add hundreds, tens and ones, regrouping when needed.
topics.trouble: Children write a two-digit column sum in one column, so 7 + 8 ones becomes "15" squeezed into the answer.

topics.title: Subtracting Three-Digit Numbers
topics.short: Break a hundred or a ten apart when you need more.
topics.trouble: Children break apart a hundred but forget to lower the hundreds digit.

topics.title: Why the Strategies Work
topics.short: Explain adding and subtracting with place value and the number line.

topics.title: Measuring with a Ruler
topics.short: Line up the end with 0 and read the length.
topics.trouble: Children line the object up with the 1 mark instead of the 0 mark, so every length is one too many.

topics.title: Bigger Units, Smaller Numbers
topics.short: The same length takes fewer large units than small ones.
topics.trouble: Children think an object measured as 24 inches is longer than one measured as 2 feet, because 24 is bigger.

topics.title: Estimating Lengths
topics.short: Estimate in inches, feet, centimeters and meters.

topics.title: How Much Longer?
topics.short: Subtract to compare two lengths.

topics.title: Length Word Problems
topics.short: Add and subtract lengths in the same unit.

topics.title: Time to Five Minutes
topics.short: Read the minute hand by counting by fives.
topics.trouble: Children read the number the minute hand points to as minutes, saying 3:04 when it is 3:20.

topics.title: A.M. and P.M.
topics.short: Morning times are a.m.; afternoon and evening times are p.m.

topics.title: Coin Values
topics.short: A penny is 1¢, a nickel 5¢, a dime 10¢ and a quarter 25¢.
topics.trouble: Children think a nickel is worth more than a dime because it is bigger.

topics.title: Counting Coins and Bills
topics.short: Count the biggest values first, then count on.
topics.trouble: Children count every coin as 1, or switch from counting by tens to fives at the wrong place.

topics.title: Money Word Problems
topics.short: Solve stories with dollars and cents.

topics.title: Picture Graphs and Bar Graphs
topics.short: Draw and read graphs with up to four groups.
topics.trouble: Children read the height of a bar between two grid lines as the lower line's number.

topics.title: Line Plots of Lengths
topics.short: Show measurements as Xs above a number line.

topics.title: Shapes by Sides, Angles and Faces
topics.short: Name triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons and cubes.

topics.title: Rows and Columns of Squares
topics.short: Split a rectangle into same-size squares and count them.

topics.title: Arrays and Repeated Addition
topics.short: Find the total in an array by adding equal rows.
topics.trouble: Children count every object one by one instead of adding the equal rows.

topics.title: Halves, Thirds and Fourths
topics.short: Split circles and rectangles into 2, 3 or 4 equal shares.
topics.trouble: Children think equal shares of the same rectangle must be the same shape, not just the same size.
